svg.text: Opening dialogue: how Ted talks the player through the first three steps
Gate 1 slice, first-person. Guidance comes from voices, never markers or a timer.
Basement engine room, then the lantern room
Shovel coal into the boiler firebox until the gauge
reaches working pressure and the dynamo whines and
the beacon flickers. Then climb to the lantern room
and inspect the arc lamp to find the burner broken.
needle won't climb on good intentions.”
Lighthouse window, dock and island gate, then…
Notice the moored rowboat, go to the island gate and
open it for the stranded sailors Arthur and Daniel.
Daniel goes down to the basement and stays there.
sailors, by the look. Go let them in
Hall, dock and launch, the Gullwater…
Talk with Ted and Arthur in the hall, board the
launch at the dock, steer the powered engine boat
across the Gullwater with Arthur guiding, dock at
the abandoned outpost and pick up the replacement
the Gullwater. Go with Arthur, Isaac.”
EVENT CHAIN (each stable event ID triggers the next lines)
Step 3 ends at RETURN_DEPARTED, where the Agent Crew's ARTHUR_RET_* calls take over for the return crossing.
Ted says where to go and why. Pillar 3: guidance comes from people.
No timer words or numbers. The storm and the ship's lights carry the pressure.
Three nudges: a hint, a sharper hint, then the exact place to go.
The creator picked one line for every moment. Assist mode adds a plain-text hint.
Characters and canon: Docs/Lore Build. Data: dialogue_opening.json (Godot 4).
